Aluminum Foil, Snowboards, Contact Lenses, Bread
videos.overview: The series premiere follows the transformation of aluminum into extremely thin household foil, the layered construction and finishing of snowboards, the precision molding of soft contact lenses, and the mixing, proofing and baking of commercial bread.

videos.title: Compact Discs, Mozzarella Cheese, Pantyhose, Fluorescent Tubes
videos.overview: Manufacturing processes include encoding and molding compact discs, turning milk into mozzarella cheese, knitting exceptionally fine synthetic fibers into pantyhose, and assembling fluorescent tubes with phosphor coatings, electrodes and gas.

videos.title: Toothpicks, Acrylic Bathtubs, Helicopters, Beer
videos.overview: The episode demonstrates how timber is sliced and shaped into toothpicks, acrylic sheets are heated and vacuum-formed into bathtubs, helicopters are assembled and tested, and grain, hops, yeast and water are brewed into beer.

videos.title: Hearing Aids, 3D Puzzles, Rubber Mats, Toilets
videos.overview: Miniature electronic components are fitted into custom hearing aids, printed designs are cut and assembled into three-dimensional puzzles, rubber is processed into durable floor mats, and vitreous china is molded, glazed and fired to produce toilets.

videos.title: Copy Paper, Jeans, Computers, Plate Glass
videos.overview: Wood pulp is refined and rolled into copy paper, denim is cut and sewn into jeans, electronic components are installed and tested in personal computers, and molten raw materials are formed into smooth sheets of plate glass.

videos.title: Nails and Staples, Safety Glasses, Fabrics, Bicycles
videos.overview: Steel wire is cut and shaped into nails and staples, impact-resistant lenses and frames become safety glasses, yarn is woven or knitted into fabric, and bicycle frames and components are assembled into finished cycles.

videos.title: Kayaks, Safety Boots, Electronic Signs, Cereals
videos.overview: The program examines the molding and outfitting of kayaks, construction of reinforced safety boots, assembly and programming of electronic signs, and large-scale preparation, cooking and packaging of breakfast cereal.

videos.title: Trucks, Adhesive Bandages, Computer Circuit Boards, Liquors
videos.overview: Heavy truck chassis, engines, cabs and bodies are brought together on an assembly line; absorbent pads and adhesive strips become bandages; conductive pathways and components are added to printed circuit boards; and fermented ingredients are distilled and matured into liquor.

videos.title: Steel, Apple Juice, Aircraft Landing Gear, Cosmetics
videos.overview: Raw materials are melted and processed into steel, apples are cleaned and pressed into juice, high-strength components are machined and assembled into aircraft landing gear, and pigments, oils and waxes are blended into cosmetics.

videos.title: Holograms, Package Printing, Skin Culture, Canned Corn
videos.overview: Laser-recorded interference patterns are used to create holograms, high-speed presses print packaging materials, laboratory techniques grow replacement skin tissue, and corn is harvested, prepared, sealed and sterilized for canning.

videos.title: Plastic Bags, Solar Panels, Plastic Fuel Tanks, Hockey Sticks
videos.overview: Plastic film is extruded, cut and sealed into bags; photovoltaic cells are connected and laminated into solar panels; durable polymers are molded into vehicle fuel tanks; and layered materials are shaped and finished into hockey sticks.

videos.title: Aluminum Screw Caps, Chocolate, Pills, Pasta
videos.overview: Aluminum sheet is stamped and threaded into bottle caps, cocoa ingredients are refined and tempered into chocolate, pharmaceutical compounds are measured and compressed into pills, and flour-and-water dough is mixed and formed into pasta.

videos.title: Bicycle Helmets, Aluminum, Automotive Brakes, Lithium-Ion Batteries
videos.overview: Expanded foam and protective shells are combined into bicycle helmets, aluminum is extracted and processed into usable metal, friction components and hydraulic parts become automotive braking systems, and precisely layered materials are assembled into rechargeable lithium-ion batteries.

videos.title: Eyeglass Lenses, Granite, Potato Chips, Microprocessors
videos.overview: The manufacturing processes behind prescription eyeglass lenses, finished granite products, mass-produced potato chips and microscopic computer processors are examined.

videos.title: Honey, Fiber-Optics, Bricks, Pipe Organs
videos.overview: Bees and beekeepers produce and harvest honey, glass is drawn into extremely fine optical fibers, clay is molded and fired into bricks, and thousands of specialized components are assembled into pipe organs.

videos.title: Personal Watercraft, Wine, Office Furniture, Ice Skates
videos.overview: Personal watercraft are molded and mechanically assembled, grapes are fermented and aged into wine, particleboard is transformed into office furniture, and shaped steel blades are fitted to ice-skate boots.

videos.title: Winter Jackets, Animation, Mushrooms, Gold Rings
videos.overview: Insulated materials are cut and sewn into winter jackets, drawings are developed into animated sequences, mushrooms are cultivated under controlled conditions, and gold alloys are formed and polished into rings.

videos.title: Hydroponic Lettuce, Construction Wood, Recycling, Fishing Flies
videos.overview: Lettuce is grown without soil in a hydroponic system, logs are processed into construction lumber, discarded materials are sorted and prepared for reuse, and feathers and fibers are tied into artificial fishing flies.

videos.title: Diamond Cuttings, Wood Doors, Paintballs, Newspapers
videos.overview: Rough diamonds are evaluated and precisely cut, lumber is shaped and joined into wooden doors, gelatin shells are filled to create paintballs, and news pages are printed and assembled at high speed.

videos.title: Carpets, Drinking Water, Laser Eye Surgery, Acoustic Guitars
videos.overview: Yarn is tufted and finished into carpet, municipal water is filtered and disinfected, lasers are used to reshape the eye during corrective surgery, and selected woods are fashioned into acoustic guitars.

videos.title: Fiberglass Boats, Clothes Dryers, Bubble Gum, Fireworks
videos.overview: Fiberglass layers are molded into boat hulls, metal cabinets and rotating drums become clothes dryers, gum base is mixed and flavored to make bubble gum, and pyrotechnic compounds are assembled into fireworks.

videos.title: Steel Safes, False Teeth, Airplanes, Maple Syrup
videos.overview: Reinforced steel is fabricated into security safes, dental impressions are used to create fitted dentures, aircraft structures and systems are assembled, and maple sap is collected and concentrated into syrup.

videos.title: Gummies, Aluminum Cans, Fish Farming, Bronze Sculptures
videos.overview: Gelatin mixtures are molded into gummy candies, aluminum sheet is formed into beverage cans, fish are raised in controlled aquaculture facilities, and artists use molds and molten metal to cast bronze sculptures.

videos.title: Aluminum Pots and Pans, Artificial Limbs, Peanut Butter, High Intensity Light Bulbs
videos.overview: Aluminum is pressed and finished into cookware, prosthetic limbs are designed and fitted to individual patients, roasted peanuts are ground into peanut butter, and specialized components are assembled into high-intensity light bulbs.

videos.title: Cars, Grocery Carts, Rapid Tooling and Prototyping, Collectible Coins
videos.overview: Automobile bodies and mechanical components come together on an assembly line, steel wire is shaped into grocery carts, computer-assisted techniques create rapid prototypes and tooling, and commemorative designs are struck into collectible coins.

videos.title: Ball Bearings, Electrical Wires, Lost Wax Process Casting, Automated Machines
videos.overview: Steel components are ground and polished into precision ball bearings, conductive metal is drawn and insulated to produce electrical wire, wax models are used to cast complex metal objects, and a compilation examines automated manufacturing machinery.

videos.title: Pre-Inked Stamps, Cranberries, Cotton Yarn, Road Signs
videos.overview: The episode examines how self-inking rubber stamps are manufactured, cranberries are harvested and processed, cotton fibers are spun into yarn, and durable road signs are printed and finished.

videos.title: Combination Locks, Pottery, Recreational Vehicles, Erasers
videos.overview: Metal components are assembled into combination locks, clay is shaped and fired into pottery, recreational vehicles are constructed and outfitted, and rubber compounds are formed into erasers.

videos.title: Wheel Loaders, Vegetable Oil, Hand Tools, Cotton Swabs
videos.overview: Heavy components are assembled into wheel loaders, seeds are pressed and refined into vegetable oil, steel is shaped into hand tools, and cotton is attached to paper stems to produce cotton swabs.

videos.title: Temporary Metal Fences, Asphalt Shingles, Expanded Polystyrene Products, Hard Candies
videos.overview: Steel tubing and wire are fabricated into temporary fencing, asphalt and mineral materials become roofing shingles, expanded polystyrene is molded into lightweight products, and cooked sugar is formed into hard candies.

videos.title: Horse-drawn Carriages, Artificial Eyes, Dog and Cat Food, Mirrors
videos.overview: Wood and metal are crafted into horse-drawn carriages, prosthetic eyes are individually shaped and painted, ingredients are processed into pet food, and sheets of glass receive reflective coatings to become mirrors.

videos.title: Yogurt, Candles, Neon Signs, Bookbindings
videos.overview: Bacterial cultures transform milk into yogurt, wax is molded into candles, glass tubes are bent and filled with gas to make neon signs, and printed pages are assembled into bound books.

videos.title: Prepared Mustard, Violins, Nuts and Bolts, Toilet Paper
videos.overview: Mustard seeds are ground and blended into prepared mustard, selected woods are shaped into violins, steel is formed and threaded into nuts and bolts, and recycled paper pulp is converted into toilet paper.

videos.title: Fresh Cut Flowers, Adhesive Tape, Tofu, Lottery Tickets
videos.overview: Flowers are harvested and prepared for commercial sale, adhesive is applied to backing material to produce tape, soybeans are processed into tofu, and security printing techniques are used to manufacture lottery tickets.

videos.title: Inflatable Watercraft, Couscous, Modelling Dough, Wicker Products
videos.overview: Coated fabric is cut and sealed into inflatable boats, semolina is formed into couscous, flour and other ingredients are blended into modeling dough, and flexible plant materials are woven into wicker products.

videos.title: Wind Generators, PVC Gloves, Thermo-formed Glass, Fire Trucks
videos.overview: Large mechanical and electrical components are assembled into wind generators, polyvinyl chloride is formed into protective gloves, heated glass is shaped in molds, and specialized equipment is installed on fire trucks.

videos.title: Car Radiators, Hatchery Chicks, Phyllo Dough, Cross-Country Skis
videos.overview: Metal tubes and fins are assembled into automotive radiators, fertilized eggs are incubated and hatched, pastry dough is stretched into extremely thin sheets, and layered materials are shaped into cross-country skis.

videos.title: Electric Baseboard Heaters, Molded Pulp Containers, Prepared Chicken, Video Games
videos.overview: Heating elements are enclosed in electric baseboard units, recycled paper pulp is molded into packaging containers, chickens are processed and prepared for sale, and computer graphics and programming are combined to create video games.

videos.title: Firefighter Boots, Garden Tools, Automated Machines, Gypsum Board
videos.overview: Protective materials are assembled into firefighter boots, steel is forged and fitted with handles to make garden tools, automated manufacturing equipment is demonstrated, and gypsum plaster is enclosed between paper layers to produce wallboard.

videos.title: Plastic Bottles and Jars, Mail, Eggs, Handcrafted Wooden Pens
videos.overview: Plastic is heated and formed into bottles and jars, letters and parcels are processed through an automated postal facility, eggs are collected, inspected and packaged, and selected woods are turned and finished into handcrafted pens.

videos.title: Plastic Injection Moulds, Automotive Oil Filters, Filing Cabinets, Blown Glass
videos.overview: Precision metal tooling is machined into plastic injection moulds, filter media and metal components are assembled into automotive oil filters, sheet steel is cut and formed into filing cabinets, and molten glass is shaped by hand using traditional glassblowing techniques.

videos.title: High-Precision Cutting Tools, Stained Glass, Semi-Trailers, Recorders
videos.overview: Hard industrial materials are shaped and sharpened into high-precision cutting tools, colored glass is cut and joined into stained-glass panels, structural components are assembled into semi-trailers, and wood or plastic is bored and finished to make recorders.

videos.title: Conga Drums, Metal Plating, Buttons
videos.overview: Wooden staves are joined and fitted with hardware and drumheads to make conga drums, objects receive decorative or protective metallic coatings through electroplating, and a range of materials is molded, drilled and polished into buttons.

videos.title: Grinding Wheels, Compost, Window Blinds, Milk
videos.overview: Abrasive grains and bonding materials are pressed and fired into grinding wheels, organic waste is decomposed and processed into compost, slats and operating mechanisms are assembled into window blinds, and raw milk is tested, pasteurized and packaged.

videos.title: Brushes and Push Brooms, Blackboards, Smoked Salmon, Zippers
videos.overview: Bristles are inserted and secured in handles and blocks to produce brushes and push brooms, smooth writing surfaces are manufactured into blackboards, salmon is cured and smoked, and interlocking teeth are attached to fabric tape to make zippers.

videos.title: 3D Commercial Signs, Hardwood Floors, Corrugated Polyethylene Pipe, Mattresses
videos.overview: Plastic and metal are cut and formed into three-dimensional commercial signs, hardwood is dried, milled and finished into flooring, molten polyethylene is extruded into corrugated pipe, and springs, foam and fabric are assembled into mattresses.

videos.title: Ceramic Tiles, Nuts, Steel Forgings, Skateboards
videos.overview: Clay is pressed, decorated, glazed and fired into ceramic tiles, edible nuts are harvested and prepared for sale, heated steel is shaped under pressure into strong forged components, and laminated wood decks are formed and fitted with skateboard hardware.

videos.title: Car Engines, Flour, Recliners, Envelopes
videos.overview: Machined blocks, pistons and other components are assembled into automobile engines, grain is cleaned and milled into flour, frames and reclining mechanisms are padded and upholstered to make recliners, and paper is cut, folded and glued into envelopes.

videos.title: Plastic Cups and Cutlery, Special Effects Makeup, Gold, Harps
videos.overview: Plastic is thermoformed or molded into disposable cups and cutlery, prosthetics and cosmetics are prepared for special-effects makeup, ore is processed and refined into gold, and carefully selected woods, mechanisms and strings are assembled into harps.

videos.title: Countertop Laminate, Frozen Treats, Children's Building Blocks, Detergents
videos.overview: Decorative paper and resin are layered and pressed into countertop laminate, flavored mixtures are prepared and frozen into treats, plastic is injection-molded into children’s building blocks, and chemical ingredients are blended and packaged as household detergents.

videos.title: Architectural Moldings, Pulleys, Industrial Rubber Hose, Sheet Vinyl Flooring
videos.overview: Wood and composite stock are cut into decorative architectural mouldings, metal components are cast and machined into commercial pulleys, reinforced rubber is built into industrial hose, and multiple layers are formed and printed to make sheet vinyl flooring.

videos.title: Putty Knives, Garage Doors, Electric Motors, Wool
videos.overview: Flexible steel blades are fitted with handles to make putty knives, panels and operating hardware are assembled into garage doors, copper windings and magnetic components are combined into electric motors, and fleece is cleaned, carded and processed into wool fiber.

videos.title: Paving Asphalt, Marshmallow Cookies, Loudspeakers, Electronic Door Locks
videos.overview: Aggregate and petroleum binder are heated and mixed to make paving asphalt, cookies and marshmallow filling are assembled into chocolate-covered treats, electrical and mechanical components are combined into loudspeakers, and electronic circuitry is installed in programmable door locks.

videos.title: Wood Burning Stoves, Orthoses, Ballet Slippers, Buses
videos.overview: Heavy steel panels and fire-resistant components are assembled into wood-burning stoves, custom supports are molded into orthoses, fabric and leather are cut and sewn into ballet slippers, and large frames, engines and passenger compartments are assembled into buses.

videos.title: Robotic Arms, Tattoos, Sanitary Napkins, Concrete Pipes
videos.overview: Motors, joints and computerized controls are assembled into industrial robotic arms, tattoo designs are transferred to skin and applied with electrically driven needles, absorbent materials are layered into sanitary napkins, and reinforced concrete is molded into large pipes.

videos.title: Hockey Gloves, Snack Cakes, Remolded Tires, Wastewater Treatment
videos.overview: Protective padding, leather and fabric are assembled into hockey gloves, batter and fillings are baked and packaged as snack cakes, worn tire casings receive new tread through remoulding, and municipal wastewater passes through mechanical and biological treatment processes.

videos.title: Ambulances, Dining Room Tables, Diatonic Accordians, Acrylic Awards
videos.overview: Vehicle bodies are modified and equipped with medical systems to create ambulances, prepared lumber is joined and finished into dining room tables, reeds, bellows and keyboards are assembled into diatonic accordions, and acrylic sheets are cut, engraved and polished into awards.

videos.title: Alkaline Batteries, Wheelchairs, Flutes, Cowboy Boots
videos.overview: Steel casings are filled with chemical components to make alkaline batteries, metal frames and seating systems are assembled into wheelchairs, metal tubing is shaped and fitted with keys to produce flutes, and leather is cut, stitched and formed into cowboy boots.

videos.title: Golf Balls, Furniture Handles, Parking Meters, Room Dividers
videos.overview: Synthetic rubber cores and molded covers are formed into golf balls, metal components are cast and finished into furniture handles, timing and payment mechanisms are installed in parking meters, and frames and decorative panels are assembled into room dividers.

videos.title: Suits of Armor, Street Light Poles, Bent Hardwood, Membrane Switches
videos.overview: Shaped steel plates are fitted together into traditional suits of armour, long sections of metal are formed and finished into street light poles, steamed hardwood is bent around molds, and printed conductive layers are laminated into membrane switches.

videos.title: Sulkies, Bagpipes, Yule Logs, Fishing Lures
videos.overview: Lightweight frames, shafts and wheels are assembled into sulkies for harness racing, wooden pipes and an airtight bag are combined to make bagpipes, sponge cake and filling are formed into decorative Yule logs, and metal, wood and plastic are shaped into fishing lures.

videos.title: Goalie Pads, Lapel Pins, Cardboard Boxes, Crystal Wine Glasses
videos.overview: Foam, synthetic materials and protective reinforcements are assembled into hockey goalie pads, stamped metal is decorated and finished into lapel pins, corrugated board is cut and folded into shipping boxes, and molten crystal is blown and shaped into wine glasses.

videos.title: Cement, Caskets, Soft Drinks, Glider Rockers
videos.overview: Limestone and other minerals are processed into cement, wood or metal shells are lined and finished into caskets, flavored syrup is carbonated and bottled as soft drinks, and upholstered seats are mounted on mechanisms to create glider rockers.

videos.title: Kitchen Knives, Mannequins, Socks, Hypodermic Needles
videos.overview: Steel blades are stamped, heat-treated and sharpened into kitchen knives, human forms are sculpted and molded into mannequins, yarn is knitted and finished into socks, and stainless-steel tubing is drawn, cut and sharpened into hypodermic needles.

videos.title: Electrical Panels, Kites, Eyeglass Frames, Toothbrushes
videos.overview: Metal enclosures, circuit breakers and conductive components are assembled into electrical panels, lightweight frames and fabric are combined into kites, metal or plastic is shaped into eyeglass frames, and clusters of nylon bristles are secured in molded toothbrush handles.

videos.title: Three-Wheeled Vehicles, Baseball Bats, Artificial Bonsais, Trombones
videos.overview: The production processes behind three-wheeled motor vehicles, wooden baseball bats, artificial bonsai trees and brass trombones are examined.

videos.title: Springs, Pavers, Pianos, Rotary Cannons
videos.overview: Steel wire is shaped and heat-treated into springs, concrete mixtures are molded into paving stones, thousands of specialized components are assembled and tuned to make pianos, and precision-machined barrels and mechanisms are combined into rotary cannons.

videos.title: Ropes, Billiard Tables, Sailboards, Cymbals
videos.overview: Individual fibers are twisted together into rope, slate and wooden frames are assembled into billiard tables, lightweight composite materials are formed into sailboards, and metal alloys are hammered and finished into cymbals.

videos.title: Seatbelts, Windows, Wax Figurines, Hot Air Balloons
videos.overview: Strong woven webbing and locking mechanisms are assembled into automotive seatbelts, glass and frame components are manufactured into windows, wax is molded and detailed into figurines, and large fabric panels are sewn together to create hot-air balloon envelopes.

videos.title: Air Filters, Billiard Cues, Ice Sculptures, Suits
videos.overview: Filter media is pleated and enclosed to make air filters, selected woods are turned and finished into billiard cues, blocks of ice are carved into decorative sculptures, and fabric is measured, cut and tailored into suits.

videos.title: Escalator Handrails, Highlighters, Guitar Strings, Wigs
videos.overview: Layers of rubber and reinforcing materials are formed into escalator handrails, fluorescent ink and molded plastic become highlighter pens, metal wire is drawn and wound into guitar strings, and natural or synthetic hair is attached and styled to produce wigs.

videos.title: Traditional Bows, Coffee Machines, Mascots, Hammocks
videos.overview: Selected woods are shaped and laminated into traditional archery bows, heating and pumping components are assembled into coffee machines, foam and fabric are fashioned into mascot costumes, and strong cords are woven into hammocks.

videos.title: Fiberglass Insulation, Wooden Ducks, Gumball Machines, Exhaust Systems
videos.overview: Molten glass is spun into fibreglass insulation, wood is carved and painted into decorative ducks, dispensing mechanisms are installed in gumball machines, and formed metal pipes and mufflers are assembled into automotive exhaust systems.

videos.title: Chains, Bagels, Vinyl Records
videos.overview: Steel rods are bent, welded and heat-treated into chains, rings of yeast dough are boiled and baked into bagels, and recorded audio is transferred to master discs used to press vinyl records.

videos.title: Windshields, English Saddles, Butter, Post Clocks
videos.overview: Layers of safety glass are shaped and laminated into automotive windshields, leather and supportive frames are crafted into English saddles, cream is churned and processed into butter, and cast housings and clock mechanisms are assembled into traditional post clocks.

videos.title: Individual Transporters, Canoes, Electric Guitars

Waffle batter is portioned and baked between patterned cooking plates, electrical conductors are drawn, stranded and insulated to produce custom cables, and massive steel blanks are forged and machined into train wheels capable of supporting heavy rail vehicles.

videos.title: Sails, Walnuts, Wheel Immobilizers, Honeycomb Structural Panels
videos.overview: Computer-designed fabric panels are cut, joined and reinforced to create sails able to withstand changing wind loads. Walnuts are cracked, separated and graded, hardened metal components are assembled into vehicle wheel immobilizers, and lightweight honeycomb cores are bonded between rigid outer skins to form exceptionally strong structural panels.

videos.title: Surfboards, Stickers, Sandwich Cookies, Concrete Roofing Tiles
videos.overview: Foam blanks are shaped into surfboards before being reinforced with fibreglass and resin and given a smooth final finish. Printed designs receive adhesive and protective coatings before being cut into stickers, baked cookie halves are paired around measured portions of filling, and coloured concrete is moulded and cured into durable roofing tiles.

videos.title: Stuffed Olives, Astrolabes, Western Saddles
videos.overview: Olives are sorted, pitted and filled before being preserved and packaged. Metal discs are engraved and assembled into working astrolabes based on traditional astronomical instruments, while Western saddles are built around rigid trees and completed with shaped padding, fitted leather and decorative tooling.

videos.title: Headphones, Diving Regulators, Reflector Light Bulbs
videos.overview: Miniature speaker drivers, wiring and cushioned housings are assembled into headphones. Precision valves, diaphragms and seals are combined and pressure-tested to create diving regulators, while reflector bulbs are formed, coated and fitted with their electrical components to concentrate light into a controlled beam.

videos.title: Fly Fishing Reels, House Paint, Weaving Looms, Ice Makers
videos.overview: Lightweight metal is machined into precisely balanced fly-fishing reels and fitted with smooth drag mechanisms. Pigments, binders and additives are blended into house paint, weaving looms coordinate warp and weft threads to produce patterned fabric, and automatic ice makers freeze water, release the finished cubes and prepare for the next cycle.

videos.title: Graphite Pencil Leads, Clarinets, Special Effects
videos.overview: Graphite and clay are blended, extruded into slender rods, fired and treated to produce smooth, durable pencil leads. Seasoned wood is drilled, turned and fitted with a complex key mechanism to make clarinets, while special-effects artists use sculpting, mould-making, flexible materials and mechanical devices to create convincing physical illusions.

videos.title: Air Boats, Onions, 3D Metal Printing, Curved Cabinet Doors
videos.overview: A flat-bottomed hull, powerful engine, large propeller and protective cage are combined to build an airboat capable of crossing shallow water and marshland. Onions are harvested, cured, graded and packed; metal powder is fused layer by layer from a digital design; and glued layers of wood are pressed over shaped forms to produce curved cabinet doors.

videos.title: Retractable Ballpoint Pens, Solar Salt, Tubas
videos.overview: Injection-moulded pen bodies are fitted with ink refills, ballpoint tips, springs and retracting mechanisms. Salt water is concentrated in large evaporation ponds until crystals can be harvested and refined, while sheets and tubes of brass are shaped, joined and polished into the long air passages and broad bell of a tuba.

videos.title: Kelp Caviar, Luxury Sailboats, Dental Crowns, High-Performance Engines
videos.overview: Dried kelp is ground and blended into a gel before being formed into caviar-like pearls and packaged in a variety of flavours. Fibreglass hulls, decks and hand-finished interiors are assembled into luxury sailboats; digital models guide the production of ceramic dental crowns; and precision-machined components are combined and tested in high-performance engines.

videos.title: Leather Briefcases, Crop Dusters, Corn Whiskey, Drag Racing Clutches
videos.overview: Bridle leather is cut, reinforced, hand-stitched and fitted with polished hardware to create traditional briefcases. Welded airframes, chemical hoppers and spray systems are assembled into crop-dusting aircraft; ground corn is fermented and distilled into whiskey; and machined plates, friction discs, springs and levers become drag-racing clutches.

videos.title: Train Rails, Desalinated Water, Racing Wheelchairs, Parquetry
videos.overview: Recycled steel is melted, cast and rolled into long sections of train rail before being straightened and inspected. Seawater passes through filtration and high-pressure membrane systems to become drinking water; lightweight tubing is shaped around an athlete’s measurements to build a racing wheelchair; and precisely cut hardwood pieces are arranged into decorative parquet flooring.

videos.title: Flight Simulators, Bookbinding, Greenhouse Tomatoes, Hurricane-Proof Shutters
videos.overview: Cockpit controls, computer-generated displays and motion systems are integrated into realistic flight simulators. Printed sheets are folded, sewn and enclosed in handcrafted covers using traditional bookbinding methods; tomatoes are cultivated under carefully regulated greenhouse conditions; and reinforced shutters are fabricated and tested to protect windows from hurricane-force winds and flying debris.

videos.title: Worcestershire Sauce, Lawn Bowls, Radio-Controlled Model Jets
videos.overview: A complex mixture of seasonings and fermented ingredients is matured, filtered and bottled as Worcestershire sauce. Dense synthetic blanks are shaped, weighted and polished to give lawn bowls their distinctive curved path, while lightweight composite airframes, radio-control equipment and miniature turbine engines are assembled into high-performance model jets.

videos.title: Pipes, Rock Climbing Gear, Leather Bike Saddles, Luxury Sports Cars
videos.overview: Fire-resistant briar wood is drilled, carved, stained and fitted with a vulcanite mouthpiece to create a smoking pipe. Aircraft-grade aluminum is forged and heat-treated into carabiners and other climbing equipment; wet leather is moulded over a metal bicycle-saddle frame; and lightweight chassis, powerful drivetrains and carefully finished body panels come together in luxury sports cars.

videos.title: Replica Foods, Traffic Cone Dispensers, Rocking Horses, London Taxis
videos.overview: Real dishes are used to make silicone moulds from which durable plastic replica foods are cast, trimmed and hand-painted. Welded frames, motors and robotic arms form machines that deploy and retrieve traffic cones; hardwood pieces are carved and joined into traditional rocking horses; and purpose-built bodies, drivetrains and passenger compartments are assembled into London taxis.

videos.title: Miniature Furniture, Garden Steam Locomotives, Hovercraft, Folding Bicycles
videos.overview: Craftspeople reproduce the joinery, upholstery and finishes of full-sized furniture in miniature. Precision-machined boilers, cylinders and running gear become working garden steam locomotives; lightweight hulls, flexible skirts and propulsion fans are assembled into hovercraft; and hinged frames with secure locking mechanisms allow bicycles to fold into compact packages.

videos.title: Crosscut Saws, Haggis, Collectible Firearms
videos.overview: Steel blades are cut, toothed, hardened and sharpened to produce crosscut saws capable of slicing cleanly across wood grain. Organ meats, oatmeal, onions and seasonings are prepared and packed into traditional haggis, while machined metal components and carefully fitted wooden stocks are finished and assembled into collectible firearms.

videos.title: Alligator Bags, Lockers, Bench Planes, Deployable Flight Recorders
videos.overview: Selected alligator hides are cut, reinforced, stitched and finished into luxury handbags. Sheet metal is punched, folded and joined to make storage lockers; cast bodies, sharpened blades and shaped handles become woodworking bench planes; and protected recording units are enclosed in deployable housings designed to preserve aircraft data after an accident.

videos.title: Grapples, Flavorings, Dog Sleds, Athletic Shoes
videos.overview: Heavy steel parts are cut, welded and fitted with hydraulic mechanisms to create industrial grapples. Natural and synthetic ingredients are extracted, measured and blended into concentrated food flavourings; shaped wooden components are joined and reinforced to build dog sleds; and layers of fabric, foam, rubber and supportive materials are cut, stitched and bonded into athletic shoes.

videos.title: Retractable Cords, Wood Frame Sports Cars, Sushi
videos.overview: Insulated electrical conductors are wound around forms and heat-treated so they repeatedly return to their compact coiled shape. Traditional timber frameworks are shaped and joined before receiving metal body panels and mechanical components in wood frame sports cars, while seasoned rice, seafood, vegetables and seaweed are carefully prepared and assembled into sushi.

videos.title: Leather Wallets, French Horns, Soy Sauce, Children's Ride-On Cars
videos.overview: Leather is cut, thinned, lined and stitched into wallets with precisely fitted pockets and compartments. Brass tubing is bent, joined and equipped with valves and a flared bell to create French horns; fermented soybeans and wheat are aged, pressed and filtered into soy sauce; and moulded bodies, electric motors, batteries and controls are assembled into children’s ride-on cars.

videos.title: Millefiori Glass Paperweights, Road Salt, Nutcrackers, Car Doors
videos.overview: Slices of brightly patterned glass cane are arranged and fused within clear glass to create millefiori paperweights. The episode also follows the processing of road salt for winter de-icing, the carving and assembly of traditional character nutcrackers, and the stamping, welding and fitting of steel panels to produce complete car doors.

videos.title: Straight Razors, Black Pudding, Steering Wheels, Inorganic Pigments
videos.overview: Steel blanks are shaped, hardened, ground and carefully honed into straight razors. Blood, fat, grain and seasonings are prepared for traditional black pudding; metal frames are padded, covered and equipped to become steering wheels; and mineral ingredients are processed into stable inorganic pigments used to colour manufactured products.

videos.title: Cast Iron Cookware, Biodiesel, Clothes Hangers, Stone Wool Insulation
videos.overview: Molten iron is poured into moulds, cleaned and finished to create durable cast iron cookware. Vegetable oil is chemically converted and purified into biodiesel, clothes hangers are shaped and assembled for strength and balance, and molten rock is spun into fibres before being compressed into fire-resistant stone wool insulation.

videos.title: Needles and Pins, Architectural Mouldings, Locomotives, Clothespins
videos.overview: Fine metal wire is straightened, cut, pointed and finished to manufacture needles and pins. Decorative profiles are reproduced as architectural mouldings, heavy structural and mechanical systems are assembled into working locomotives, and shaped wooden pieces are joined with metal springs to produce clothespins.

videos.title: Filigree Glass, Fish Food, Motor Homes
videos.overview: Fine strands and rods of coloured glass are heated, arranged and fused into the intricate patterns of filigree glass. Nutritional ingredients are ground, blended and formed into fish food, while a vehicle chassis receives insulated walls, utilities, furnishings and fitted interiors to become a self-contained motor home.

videos.title: Surgical Instruments, Ketchup, Double-Decker Buses, Walking Sticks
videos.overview: Medical-grade steel is forged or machined, polished and inspected to create precise surgical instruments. Tomatoes are cooked, strained, seasoned and bottled as ketchup; large chassis and body sections are assembled into double-decker buses; and selected wood is straightened, shaped and finished into walking sticks.

videos.title: Audio Vacuum Tubes, Light Bars, Wood Model Aircraft, Metal Snare Drums
videos.overview: Delicate electrodes and control grids are assembled inside glass envelopes that are evacuated and sealed to form audio vacuum tubes. Optical modules, wiring and housings are combined into emergency light bars; lightweight wooden pieces are cut and joined into model aircraft; and formed metal shells are fitted with heads, tensioning hardware and snare wires to create snare drums.

videos.title: Kitchen Accessories, Central Vacuums, Papier-Mâché Animals, Hydraulic Cylinders
videos.overview: Metal, wood and plastic components are shaped and finished into practical kitchen accessories. Motors, filters and collection housings are assembled into central vacuum systems; layers of paper and adhesive are moulded, dried and painted as papier-mâché animals; and precision tubes, rods, pistons and seals are combined into hydraulic cylinders.

videos.title: Clay Liquor Jugs, Poultry Deli Meats, NASCAR Engines
videos.overview: Clay is formed into traditional liquor jugs before the vessels are dried, glazed and fired. Poultry is prepared, seasoned, formed and cooked into uniform deli meats, while specially machined blocks, cylinder heads and internal components are assembled and tested as high-output NASCAR racing engines.

videos.title: Digital Dentistry, Nail Clippers, Poster Restoration, Canola Oil
videos.overview: Digital scans and computer-guided equipment are used to design and manufacture precisely fitted dental restorations. Steel is stamped, hardened, sharpened and assembled into nail clippers; damaged posters are cleaned, flattened, repaired and reinforced; and canola seeds are cleaned, crushed and refined into cooking oil.

videos.title: Dial Thermometers, Hummus, Spent Fuel Containers, Straw Sombreros
videos.overview: Temperature-sensitive mechanisms are connected to calibrated faces and protective housings to produce dial thermometers. Cooked chickpeas are blended with tahini, oil and seasonings to make hummus; heavy engineered components are fabricated into shielded containers for spent nuclear fuel; and straw is woven, shaped and trimmed into traditional sombreros.

videos.title: Tequila, Waterbeds, Flip Flops, Silver
videos.overview: Blue agave hearts are cooked, crushed, fermented and distilled to produce tequila. Sheets of flexible vinyl are cut, heat-sealed and fitted with valves to form waterbed mattresses; moulded soles and straps are assembled into flip-flops; and silver-bearing material is refined, melted and cast into usable forms.

videos.title: Composite Propane Cylinders, Salsa, Water-Pumping Windmills, Dragsters
videos.overview: Lightweight liners are wrapped with resin-impregnated fibres, cured and pressure-tested to create composite propane cylinders. Vegetables and seasonings are cleaned, chopped, blended and packaged as salsa; galvanized steel components are assembled into windmills that operate mechanical water pumps; and reinforced chassis, powerful engines and specialized drivetrains are combined into dragsters.

videos.title: Decorative Sombreros, Salad Dressings & Marinades, Cap Guns, Regenerative Medicine
videos.overview: Traditional hat bodies are shaped into broad-brimmed sombreros before receiving decorative trim and detailed embroidery. Oils, vinegars and seasonings are blended into salad dressings and marinades; moulded toy components are assembled into cap guns; and regenerative-medicine researchers combine living cells with supportive structures to produce replacement tissue.

videos.title: Cheese Graters, Hot Sauce, Silver Jewellery, Traditional Mexican Chairs
videos.overview: Stainless-steel sheets are perforated, sharpened and formed into cheese graters. Peppers and seasonings are processed into bottled hot sauce, silver is shaped, joined and polished into jewellery, and wooden frameworks with leather seating are handcrafted into traditional Mexican chairs known as equipales.

videos.title: Game Calls, Mayonnaise, Traditional Razor Blades, Butterfly Safety Razors
videos.overview: Reeds and resonating chambers are carefully shaped to produce game calls that imitate wild animals. Oil, eggs and acidic ingredients are emulsified into mayonnaise; thin steel is hardened, ground and coated to make razor blades; and precision components are assembled into butterfly-opening safety razors.

videos.title: Corn Tortillas, Crankshafts & Camshafts, Bush Planes, Aluminum Bike Wheels
videos.overview: Prepared corn dough is portioned, flattened and baked into tortillas. Engine components are forged or cast before being machined and hardened into crankshafts and camshafts; rugged airframes are equipped for bush flying; and aluminium rims, hubs and spokes are assembled into lightweight bicycle wheels.

videos.title: Folding Kayaks, Piñatas, Garbage Trucks, Ceramic Composite Brake Discs
videos.overview: Sectional frameworks and waterproof skins are fitted together to create kayaks that collapse for transportation. Paper and cardboard forms are decorated as piñatas, commercial truck chassis receive hydraulically operated refuse bodies and compactors, and fibre-reinforced materials are heated and machined into high-performance ceramic composite brake discs.

videos.title: Rolled Wafers, Wood Pellets, Class & Championship Rings
videos.overview: Thin layers of batter are baked and rolled while still warm to produce crisp wafer tubes. Dried wood residue is ground and compressed into dense heating pellets, while cast precious-metal blanks are polished, engraved and fitted with stones to create class and championship rings.

videos.title: Speed Skates, Synthetic Rubber, Cocoa Beans, Bulk Chocolate
videos.overview: Supportive boots are fitted with long, carefully aligned blades to create speed skates. Chemical ingredients are polymerized and compounded into synthetic rubber, cocoa beans are fermented and dried after harvesting, and roasted beans are ground, refined and blended into bulk chocolate.

videos.title: Custom Steering Wheels, Aerospace Fuel Lines, Apple Pies, Household Radiators
videos.overview: Metal steering-wheel frames are padded, shaped and hand-covered to suit individual vehicles. Aerospace tubing is bent, fitted and pressure-tested for use as fuel lines; pastry shells are filled and baked into apple pies; and pressed metal panels are welded and finished as household radiators.

videos.title: Whips, Automated Pizza Makers, Incense Cones, Scale Turbine Engines
videos.overview: Strips of leather are tapered and tightly braided into flexible whips. Automated machines portion dough, sauce and toppings to prepare pizzas; aromatic powders and binders are moulded and dried into incense cones; and miniature compressor and turbine components are machined, balanced and assembled into working scale engines.

videos.title: Heather Gems, Instant Film, Beet Sugar, Electric Roadsters
videos.overview: Dried heather stems are dyed, bundled with resin and compressed into patterned blocks that can be cut and polished into jewellery. Photosensitive layers and chemical pods are combined into instant film, sugar is extracted and crystallized from sliced beets, and battery packs and electric drivetrains are installed in lightweight roadsters.

videos.title: Underwater Robots, Lasagne, Band Saws, Ski & Trekking Poles
videos.overview: Waterproof housings, cameras, thrusters and electronic controls are assembled into remotely operated underwater robots. Pasta sheets are layered with sauces and fillings to produce lasagne; toothed steel strips are welded into continuous band-saw blades; and lightweight tubes receive grips, baskets and hardened tips to become ski and trekking poles.

videos.title: Laminated Wood Beams, Sport Utility Vehicles, Veggie Burgers, Wood Boring Augers
videos.overview: Selected lengths of timber are coated with structural adhesive, stacked and pressed into strong laminated beams. Vehicle bodies, drivetrains and interiors are assembled into sport utility vehicles; plant-based ingredients are mixed and formed into veggie burgers; and spiral steel flights are shaped and attached to shafts to create wood-boring augers.

videos.title: Turbochargers, Enchiladas, Watches
videos.overview: Precision-machined compressor and turbine wheels are balanced and installed inside heat-resistant housings to create turbochargers. Tortillas are filled, rolled and covered with sauce to prepare enchiladas, while tiny gears, springs, dials and cases are assembled and regulated to produce mechanical watches.

videos.title: Patterned Glass Panels, Road Cases, Stop-Frame Animation
videos.overview: Molten glass is formed with textured patterns to create decorative and privacy panels. Durable plywood shells are reinforced with metal edging, corners and locking hardware to make protective road cases, while models and sets are moved in tiny increments and photographed one frame at a time to produce stop-frame animation.

videos.title: Industrial Wire Ropes, Living Walls, Large Format Cameras, Gemstones
videos.overview: Individual steel wires are twisted into strands and wound around a central core to produce heavy-duty industrial wire ropes. Plants, growing media and irrigation systems are combined into vertical living walls; precision bodies, bellows and film holders are assembled into large-format cameras; and rough gemstones are cut and polished to reveal their colour and pattern.

videos.title: Chocolate Coins, Floor Heating Systems, Pedal Cars, Latex Swords
videos.overview: Tempered chocolate is moulded into coins and wrapped in embossed metallic foil. Electrical heating elements are arranged beneath flooring to provide even radiant heat, child-sized pedal cars are assembled from shaped body and drive components, and flexible theatrical swords are cast in moulds and finished with layers of coloured latex.

videos.title: Farmed Caviar, Intake Manifolds, Motorcycle Jackets, Shovels & Spades
videos.overview: Farm-raised sturgeon provide roe that is carefully separated, graded and salted to produce caviar. Intake manifolds are cast and machined to distribute air through an engine, protective motorcycle jackets are cut and sewn from leather with reinforced panels, and steel blades are shaped, hardened and fitted to handles to make shovels and spades.

videos.title: Wax Figures, Awnings, Sandwich Crackers, Pewter Tankards
videos.overview: Detailed sculptures and moulds are used to create lifelike wax figures, which are completed with painted features and individually applied hair. Weather-resistant fabric is cut and mounted on folding frames to make awnings, crisp crackers are baked and paired around a measured layer of filling, and molten pewter is formed and polished into traditional tankards.

videos.title: Pipe Cleaners, Blue Stilton Cheese, Smart Electric Meters, Telescopes
videos.overview: Soft fibres are trapped between twisting wires to produce flexible pipe cleaners. Cultured milk is coagulated, drained and pierced so the characteristic blue mould can develop in Stilton cheese; electronic measuring components are calibrated inside smart electric meters; and precisely shaped lenses or mirrors are aligned within telescope bodies.

videos.title: Fish Replicas, Siren Systems, Pre-Packaged Sandwiches, Candlesticks
videos.overview: Moulds taken from real specimens are used to cast lightweight fish replicas, which are carefully painted to reproduce natural markings. Electronic and acoustic components are assembled into powerful warning sirens, ingredients are portioned onto bread and sealed in protective packaging, and metal is cast or shaped before being polished into decorative candlesticks.

videos.title: Tapioca Pudding, Snow Ploughs, Paddle Boats, Fibre Cement Siding
videos.overview: Tapioca pearls are cooked with dairy ingredients and sweeteners to produce a smooth packaged pudding. Heavy steel plates are cut, curved and welded into snow ploughs; moulded hulls are fitted with pedal-driven propulsion systems to make paddle boats; and cement reinforced with cellulose fibres is formed, cured and finished as exterior siding.

videos.title: Rally Cars, Pork Pies, Floating Fountains, Artificial Stone Ornaments
videos.overview: Production vehicles are stripped, reinforced and equipped with specialised engines, suspension and safety systems to create rally cars. Pastry shells are filled and baked into traditional pork pies, pumps and nozzles are mounted on floating platforms to create fountains, and moulded mineral mixtures are cured and finished as artificial stone ornaments.

videos.title: Cufflinks, Blueberry Turnovers, Dashboards, Earthenware Pottery
videos.overview: Small metal components are cast or cut, joined and polished to create decorative cufflinks. Pastry is folded around blueberry filling and baked into turnovers, moulded structures are fitted with instruments and electronics to form vehicle dashboards, and shaped clay is dried, glazed and fired into earthenware pottery.

videos.title: Pharmaceutical Blister Packs, Deli Slicers, Oysters, Weathervanes
videos.overview: Plastic film is heated and formed into individual cavities, filled with medication and sealed with foil to produce pharmaceutical blister packs. Stainless-steel blades, motors and adjustable carriages are assembled into deli slicers; oysters are cultivated, harvested and prepared for sale; and shaped metal ornaments are balanced on rotating mounts to make weathervanes.

videos.title: Top & Bowler Hats, Solar Water Heaters, Sticky Buns, Electrostatic Speakers
videos.overview: Felt hat bodies are steamed, stretched over wooden forms and trimmed into top hats and bowlers. Absorbing collectors, pipes and insulated tanks are assembled into solar water-heating systems; enriched dough is rolled with a sweet filling, sliced and baked into sticky buns; and a thin charged diaphragm is suspended between perforated panels to create electrostatic speakers.

videos.title: Turntables, Steam Engines, Playground Equipment, Teflon Pans
videos.overview: Platters, motors, tonearms and electronic controls are assembled and calibrated to produce turntables. Boilers and precision-machined moving components are combined into working steam engines, shaped metal and plastic parts are coated and assembled into playground equipment, and formed cookware receives layers of non-stick coating before curing and final assembly.

videos.title: Garden Forks, English Toffee, Paint Chip Cards, Bundt Pans
videos.overview: Steel is shaped, welded and fitted with handles to produce sturdy garden forks. Sugar and butter are cooked and cooled into English toffee; carefully matched paint samples are applied to display cards; and aluminium is formed into deeply fluted Bundt pans before receiving a non-stick finish.

videos.title: Pewter Flasks, Potato Salad, Hydrogen Fuel Cells, Engineered Wood Siding
videos.overview: Pewter components are formed, joined and polished into traditional pocket flasks. Potatoes are cooked, cut and blended with dressing on an industrial production line; membranes, plates and seals are stacked into hydrogen fuel cells; and wood fibres are bonded with resin, pressed and finished as durable exterior siding.

videos.title: Canvas Wall Tents, Peace Pipes, Shredded Wheat Cereal, Cannons
videos.overview: Heavy canvas is measured, cut and sewn into weather-resistant wall tents. Stone bowls and wooden stems are shaped into ceremonial peace pipes; cooked whole wheat is drawn into fine strands, layered and baked into shredded wheat cereal; and cast metal barrels are machined and mounted on wheeled cannon carriages.

videos.title: Robotic Hunting Decoys, Canned Tomatoes, Scoreboards, Lassos
videos.overview: Moulded animal bodies are equipped with motors and remote controls to create moving hunting decoys. Tomatoes are sorted, peeled and sealed in cans for heat processing; electronic displays and control systems are assembled into scoreboards; and strands of fibre are twisted into rope and formed into working lassos.

videos.title: Turf Grass, Beef Jerky, Wood Chippers, Bowling Pins
videos.overview: Grass is cultivated in prepared fields before being cut into strips and rolled for transport. Lean meat is sliced, seasoned and slowly dried into beef jerky; heavy steel frames, feed mechanisms and cutting blades are assembled into wood chippers; and laminated maple is turned, coated and decorated to make bowling pins.

videos.title: Multi-Tools, Jojoba Oil, Marionettes
videos.overview: Blades, pliers and other implements are stamped from steel, hardened and folded into compact multi-tools. Jojoba seeds are processed and pressed to extract their liquid wax, while wooden figures are carved, painted, jointed and connected by strings to control bars to create handcrafted marionettes.

videos.title: Fish Decoys, Film Digitization, Cylinder Stoves, Concrete Light Poles
videos.overview: Wooden fish decoys are carved, balanced and painted to attract fish beneath the ice. Motion-picture film is cleaned and scanned frame by frame into digital files; sheet steel is rolled and welded into compact cylinder stoves; and reinforced concrete is moulded and cured into tall light poles.

videos.title: Bamboo Bicycles, Chainsaw Art, Breath Mints, Manual Motorcycle Transmissions
videos.overview: Selected bamboo tubes are dried, treated and joined to form lightweight bicycle frames. Artists transform large logs into sculptures with chainsaws; flavouring and sweeteners are mixed, compressed and finished as breath mints; and precision-cut gears and shafts are assembled into manual motorcycle transmissions.

videos.title: Dinnerware, Air Brake Tanks, Frosted Cereal, Fossils
videos.overview: Clay is formed, glazed and fired to produce matching pieces of dinnerware. Steel sections are shaped, welded and pressure-tested as tanks for vehicle air-brake systems; cooked grain is flaked, toasted and coated with a sweet frosting; and fossils are exposed, stabilized and prepared by removing the surrounding rock.

videos.title: Clay, Pitted Prunes, Spurs, Polyurethane Tires
videos.overview: Raw clay is excavated, crushed, analysed and blended into a consistent material for industrial use. Dried plums are softened, mechanically pitted and graded; metal is shaped and decorated into riding spurs; and liquid polyurethane is poured into moulds and cured around wheel hubs to produce resilient tires.

videos.title: Tasers, Canned Soup, Jaw Harps & Mouth Bows, Diving Boards
videos.overview: Electronic circuits, batteries and probe cartridges are assembled and tested to produce conducted-energy devices. Soup ingredients are cooked, portioned into cans and sterilized; metal reeds and resonating frames are fashioned into jaw harps and mouth bows; and layers of reinforced material are moulded into flexible diving boards.

videos.title: Navajo Rugs, Crude Oil, Kaleidoscopes, Titanium Dental Implants
videos.overview: Wool is cleaned, spun and dyed before being woven by hand into traditional Navajo rugs. Crude oil is brought to the surface and separated from water and gas for transportation; angled mirrors and coloured pieces are enclosed inside kaleidoscopes; and titanium is precision-machined, cleaned and sterilized to create threaded dental implants.

videos.title: Space Pens, Reef Aquariums, Metal Caskets, Composite Bike Wheels
videos.overview: Pressurized ink cartridges and precision ballpoint tips are assembled into pens designed to write in extreme conditions. Glass or acrylic panels, lighting and filtration equipment are combined into reef aquariums; sheet metal is formed, welded and upholstered to produce caskets; and layers of composite fibre are moulded and cured into lightweight bicycle wheels.

videos.title: Native Healing Drums, Raisins, Stereoscopic Viewers, Ribbon Microphones
videos.overview: Traditional wooden drum shells are fitted with prepared hides to create Native healing drums. Grapes are dried, cleaned and sorted into raisins; paired images and viewing lenses are assembled into stereoscopic viewers; and a delicate metal ribbon is suspended within a magnetic field to produce highly responsive ribbon microphones.

videos.title: Horse Bits, Oat Cereal, Turquoise Jewellery, Electric Scooters
videos.overview: Metal components are shaped, polished and joined to produce horse bits suited to different styles of riding. Oats are cleaned and processed into breakfast cereal; pieces of turquoise are cut, polished and mounted in silver jewellery; and frames, electric motors, batteries, brakes and controls are assembled into electric scooters.

videos.title: Nail Nippers, Jade Putters, Ice Cider, Water Skis
videos.overview: Stainless-steel components are formed, hardened and sharpened before being joined into precision nail nippers. Jade is cut and polished for use in distinctive golf putters; the concentrated juice of naturally frozen apples is fermented into ice cider; and shaped cores are reinforced and finished to create durable water skis.

videos.title: Stagecoaches, Road Reflectors, Fire Baked Pottery, Custom Motorcycle Tanks
videos.overview: Wooden bodies, undercarriages, suspension systems and wheels are handcrafted into traditional stagecoaches. Optical elements are moulded into road reflectors that return light toward approaching drivers; clay vessels are shaped and fired using traditional methods; and sheet metal is formed, welded and finished into custom motorcycle fuel tanks.

videos.title: Replica Clay Pipes, Drinking Fountains, Orange Liqueur, Compound Bows
videos.overview: Clay is pressed into moulds, dried and fired to reproduce historic smoking pipes. Metal housings, valves and cooling systems are assembled into drinking fountains; orange peel, spirits and sugar are combined to make orange liqueur; and precisely engineered risers, flexible limbs, cams and strings are fitted together to create compound bows.

videos.title: Tissues, Travel Trailers, Slippers, Motorcycle Helmets
videos.overview: Wood pulp is transformed into thin sheets of soft paper before being cut, folded and boxed as facial tissues. Insulated walls, plumbing, electrical systems and furnishings are installed on wheeled chassis to build travel trailers; fabric, padding and soles are joined into slippers; and protective shells, impact-absorbing liners and retention straps are assembled into motorcycle helmets.

videos.title: U-Locks, Tepees, Croissants, Rolling Luggage
videos.overview: Heavy steel is bent, hardened and coated to form the shackle of a secure U-lock. Fabric coverings are measured and sewn to fit the supporting poles of tepees; layers of yeast dough and butter are repeatedly folded, shaped, proofed and baked into croissants; and durable cases are fitted with wheels, handles and internal frames to make rolling luggage.

videos.title: Prams, Factory-Built Homes, Wood Flutes, Bicycle Tires
videos.overview: Metal frames, suspension components, wheels and upholstered bodies are assembled into traditional prams. Houses are constructed in factory-controlled sections before being transported for final installation; selected wood is bored, shaped and tuned into flutes; and layers of rubber, fabric reinforcement and steel beads are moulded and vulcanized into bicycle tires.

videos.title: Thinning Shears, Wagon Wheels, Toaster Pastries, Violin Bows
videos.overview: Steel blades are shaped, toothed, hardened and sharpened to produce hair-thinning shears. Wooden hubs, spokes and rim sections are fitted together and reinforced to make wagon wheels; sheets of pastry are filled, sealed, baked and coated to create toaster pastries; and carefully selected wood is shaped, curved and fitted with horsehair to produce violin bows.

videos.title: Cast Iron Tubs, Hopi Kachina Dolls, Mine Truck Engine, Memory Cards
videos.overview: Molten iron is cast into heavy bathtubs before the surfaces are cleaned and coated with durable enamel. Cottonwood roots are carved and painted into traditional Hopi Kachina dolls; enormous mine-truck engines are dismantled, inspected, repaired and reassembled; and semiconductor chips are mounted, enclosed and tested to create compact memory cards.

videos.title: Cycling Shoes, Yurts, Marine Plywood, Oil and Encaustic Paint
videos.overview: Supportive uppers are shaped and bonded to rigid soles equipped for bicycle-cleat systems to make cycling shoes. Collapsible lattice walls, roof poles and protective coverings are assembled into yurts; thin wood veneers are cross-laminated with water-resistant adhesive to produce marine plywood; and finely ground pigments are blended with oil or heated wax to make oil and encaustic paints.

videos.title: Paper Fans, Walnut Oil, Copper
videos.overview: Decorated paper is cut, folded and mounted on slender ribs to create folding fans. Shelled walnuts are ground and pressed before their oil is filtered and bottled, while copper-bearing material is processed and refined before the finished metal is formed and drawn into useful products such as electrical wire.

videos.title: Gut Strings, Absinthe, Belt Buckles, Lever Locks
videos.overview: Prepared animal intestines are split, twisted, dried and polished into traditional strings for musical instruments. Herbs are steeped and distilled to produce absinthe; metal blanks are cast, stamped or engraved into decorative belt buckles; and precisely shaped levers, springs and bolts are enclosed within the cases of lever locks.

videos.title: Rubber Gloves, Soap Carvings, Aircraft Cabinets, Motorcycle Brake Locks
videos.overview: Ceramic hand forms are coated with liquid rubber, cured and stripped to produce flexible protective gloves. Blocks of soap are cut and sculpted into intricate decorative figures; lightweight panels, veneers and hardware are assembled into cabinets for aircraft interiors; and hardened metal components are fitted with locking mechanisms to create motorcycle brake locks.

videos.title: Powder Horns, Handcrafted Molds, Pierogi, Inner Tubes
videos.overview: Animal horns are cleaned, heated, shaped and polished before being fitted with plugs and pouring spouts for use as traditional powder horns. Craftspeople produce precision moulds for decorative glassware; rounds of dough are folded around savoury fillings to make pierogies; and rubber tubing is extruded, joined, fitted with valves and vulcanized into tire inner tubes.

videos.title: Lace, Antique Frame Replicas, Orchids, Unicycle Wheel Hubs
videos.overview: Thousands of threads are guided through specialised machinery to create complex lace patterns. Ornamental profiles are reproduced, joined and finished as replicas of antique picture frames; orchids are propagated and cultivated under carefully controlled greenhouse conditions; and metal blanks are machined and drilled into hubs for unicycle wheels.

videos.title: External Hard Drives, Frozen Shrimp, Thai Rice Boxes, Paper Towels
videos.overview: Disk drives, control electronics and connection ports are installed inside protective enclosures to make external hard drives. Shrimp are sorted, cleaned, peeled and rapidly frozen; thin strips of bamboo are prepared and woven into traditional Thai rice boxes; and absorbent paper is formed, embossed, perforated and wound into rolls of paper towels.

videos.title: Tea, Roof Finials, Artificial Flowers, Alloy Wheels
videos.overview: Fresh tea leaves are picked, withered, rolled, oxidized and dried to develop their flavour and aroma. Decorative roof finials are shaped and finished to withstand the weather; fabric petals and leaves are cut, coloured and assembled into artificial flowers; and molten alloy is cast, machined and coated to produce lightweight vehicle wheels.

videos.title: Gel Caps, Playground Spring Riders, Frozen Pancakes, Natural Rubber
videos.overview: Gelatin is prepared and formed into matching capsule halves before the finished gel caps are inspected and packaged. Moulded figures are mounted on heavy coil springs to create playground riders; batter is portioned, cooked, cooled and frozen into ready-to-heat pancakes; and latex collected from rubber trees is coagulated, rolled and dried into natural rubber.

videos.title: Paper Umbrellas, Coal, Aircraft Seats, Cremation Urns
videos.overview: Slender bamboo pieces are joined into folding frames and covered with decorated paper to make traditional umbrellas. Coal is excavated, transported, crushed and sorted; lightweight frames, padding and upholstery are assembled and tested as aircraft seats; and carefully shaped vessels are finished and decorated as cremation urns.

videos.title: Aluminum Canoes, Wooden Stave Bowls, Wheelchair Accessible Vans, Marimbas
videos.overview: Sheets of aluminum are formed and joined around supporting ribs to create lightweight canoes. Angled wooden staves are glued into hollow forms and turned into bowls; vans receive lowered floors, ramps and other accessibility equipment; and carefully selected wooden bars are cut, tuned and mounted above resonators to produce marimbas.

videos.title: Indy Car Seats, Paper Flowers, Stand-by Generators
videos.overview: A racing driver’s body is measured and moulded to create a closely fitted seat that provides support and protection inside an Indy car. Paper is cut, coloured and shaped into realistic flowers, while engines, alternators, control systems and protective housings are assembled and tested as standby generators.

videos.title: Customized Knee Replacements, Leaf Springs, Lavender Essential Oil, Rivets and Rivet Tools
videos.overview: Medical scans and computer models guide the production of customized knee-replacement components designed for an individual patient. Steel strips are cut, heat-treated and curved into vehicle leaf springs; harvested lavender is steam-distilled to extract its essential oil; and metal blanks are formed into rivets alongside the tools used to install them.

videos.title: Cast Iron Stoves, Ultralight Aircraft, Snow Groomers, Rubber Bands
videos.overview: Molten iron is poured into moulds, cleaned and finished before the heavy castings are assembled into wood-burning stoves. Lightweight structural components are joined into ultralight aircraft; tracked chassis, hydraulic systems and grooming equipment are combined into machines that maintain snow-covered trails; and cured rubber tubes are sliced into individual rubber bands.

videos.title: Barber Chairs, Sewage Pumps, Bimini Boat Tops, Diesel Filters
videos.overview: Steel frames, hydraulic lifting mechanisms, padding and upholstery are assembled into adjustable barber chairs. Motors and impellers are enclosed in corrosion-resistant housings to create sewage pumps; marine fabric is measured and sewn to fit folding frames for Bimini boat tops; and porous filter elements are enclosed in steel housings to remove soot from diesel exhaust.

videos.title: Car Tires, Silk, Art Conservation, Scuba Tanks
videos.overview: Different rubber compounds are mixed and assembled with reinforcing fabric, steel belts and tread before being moulded and vulcanized into car tires. Fine filaments are unwound from silkworm cocoons and combined into thread; conservators clean, stabilize and repair ageing works of art; and high-pressure metal cylinders are formed, heat-treated and tested to produce scuba tanks.

videos.title: Electric Stand-Up Vehicles, Frozen Fruit, Beer Coasters, Forged Door Handles
videos.overview: Steel frames, electric motors, rechargeable batteries and upright control systems are assembled into compact stand-up vehicles. Fresh fruit is washed, prepared and rapidly frozen to preserve its quality; absorbent wood pulp is pressed, dried and printed into beer coasters; and heated metal blanks are forged, machined and finished to create decorative door handles.

videos.title: Rock Crushers, Fabric Lampshades, Cake Sprinkles, Steam Irons
videos.overview: Heavy steel housings, powerful drive systems and hardened crushing components are assembled into machines that reduce large rocks to smaller aggregate. Fabric is laminated, cut and attached to wire frames to produce lampshades; sweetened mixtures are extruded, dried and coloured into cake sprinkles; and heated soleplates, thermostats and water reservoirs are combined in steam irons.

videos.title: Indy Steering Wheels, Mixed Salad, Wind Turbines
videos.overview: Lightweight materials are shaped around hand grips and fitted with switches, displays and quick-release hubs to create specialized Indy-car steering wheels. Fresh vegetables are washed, cut, dried and combined into packaged salads, while towers, nacelles and enormous composite blades are manufactured and assembled into wind turbines.

videos.title: Blast Doors, Lipstick, Artificial Palm Trees, Brass Plaques
videos.overview: Thick steel plates, internal reinforcement and heavy locking mechanisms are combined to produce doors capable of resisting powerful explosions. Waxes, oils and pigments are blended and moulded into lipstick; sculpted trunks and synthetic fronds become artificial palm trees; and engraved or cast brass plates are polished and finished as decorative plaques.

videos.title: Carbon Fibre, Antique Frame Restoration, Railcar Movers, Hood Ornaments
videos.overview: Synthetic fibres are stretched and heated in controlled furnaces until they become strong, lightweight carbon fibre. Conservators clean and stabilize antique picture frames before replacing damaged ornament and gilding; compact traction machines are assembled to move railway cars; and cast metal figures are polished and plated to create hood ornaments.

videos.title: Sawhorses & Toolboxes, Sorbet Pops, School Buses
videos.overview: Durable moulded and metal components are assembled into portable sawhorses and toolboxes designed for construction work. Fruit mixtures are portioned into moulds and frozen into sorbet pops, while reinforced body panels, passenger seats, doors and safety equipment are installed on heavy vehicle chassis to build school buses.

videos.title: Sanders, Solid Terrain Models, Stucco, High-Speed Roll-Up Doors
videos.overview: Motors, abrasive pads and dust-control components are assembled into powered sanders. Digital geographical data guides the production of detailed solid terrain models; mineral ingredients are blended into stucco for coating buildings; and flexible door panels, tracks, sensors and high-speed motors are combined into rapidly opening industrial doors.

videos.title: Pressed Glass, Pickup Truck Caps, Alpaca Yarn, Utility Knives
videos.overview: Measured portions of molten glass are pressed into moulds to create precisely shaped decorative and functional objects. Fibreglass shells are moulded and fitted with windows and hardware to form pickup-truck caps; alpaca fleece is cleaned, carded and spun into yarn; and sharpened blades are installed in moulded handles to produce utility knives.

videos.title: Life Casting, Downdraft Cooktops, Compression Hosiery, Electric Motorcycles
videos.overview: Flexible moulding materials capture the contours of a living subject before plaster or resin is poured to create a detailed life cast. Burners and electric heating elements are combined with built-in ventilation systems in downdraft cooktops; specialized knitting machines produce hosiery with graduated compression; and batteries, electric motors and control electronics are installed in motorcycle frames.

videos.title: Motorcycle Sidecars, Frozen French Toast, Refrigerator Compressors, Superchargers
videos.overview: Metal frames and shaped passenger bodies are built, painted and fitted to motorcycles as sidecars. Slices of bread are coated in an egg mixture, cooked and rapidly frozen into prepared French toast; electric motors and pumping mechanisms are sealed inside refrigerator compressors; and precision-machined rotors are assembled into engine superchargers.

videos.title: Custom Knee Braces, Ductless Air Conditioners, Window Film, Motorcycle Exhaust Systems
videos.overview: Measurements and moulds of a patient’s leg guide the shaping of supportive shells, hinges and padding for custom knee braces. Heat-exchange coils, fans, compressors and electronic controls are assembled into ductless air-conditioning systems; thin polymer layers are coated and bonded into window film; and bent metal tubing and mufflers become motorcycle exhaust systems.

videos.title: Solid State Drives, Eye Shadow, Limousines, Dead Blow Hammers
videos.overview: Flash-memory chips and controllers are mounted on circuit boards, enclosed and tested to create solid-state drives. Pigments and binding agents are blended and pressed into eye-shadow pans; passenger vehicles are cut, lengthened and structurally reinforced to become limousines; and hollow hammer heads are filled with loose material that absorbs rebound in dead-blow hammers.

videos.title: Dragster Tires, Icing, Floating Docks, Spiral Pipes
videos.overview: Specialized rubber compounds and reinforcing materials are layered, moulded and vulcanized into dragster tires designed to withstand extreme acceleration. Sugar, fats and flavourings are blended into smooth icing; buoyant sections and supporting frames are assembled into floating docks; and continuous steel strips are helically formed and welded into large spiral pipes.

videos.title: Motion Sensors, Belt Loaders, Pheasant Breeding, Diving Helmets
videos.overview: Electronic sensing components are installed, programmed and calibrated to create motion detectors. Airport belt loaders are assembled around adjustable conveyor systems; pheasants are bred and raised under controlled conditions; and metal shells, viewing ports, air connections and communication equipment are combined into professional diving helmets.

videos.title: Rawhide Lampshades, Chocolate Chip Cookies, MRI Scanners
videos.overview: Prepared rawhide is stretched over frames, dried and decorated to produce distinctive lampshades. Cookie dough is mixed, portioned with chocolate chips and baked on a continuous production line, while powerful magnets, gradient coils, electronic systems and protective housings are assembled and tested as MRI scanners.

videos.title: Noise Barrier Walls, Front-Load Washers, Bourbon, Flexible Circuit Boards
videos.overview: Sound-absorbing materials are formed into roadside panels designed to reduce traffic noise. Drums, motors, pumps and electronic controls are installed in front-loading washing machines; fermented grain mash is distilled and aged in charred barrels to produce bourbon; and conductive pathways are formed on thin flexible substrates to make circuit boards.

videos.title: Railway Bridge Ties, Membrane Filters, Hydraulic Post Drivers, Bi-Planes
videos.overview: Heavy timbers are cut, drilled and treated for use as railway ties on bridges. Selective membranes are formed and installed in filtration units; hydraulic mechanisms are assembled into machines that drive posts into the ground; and wooden or metal airframes, wings, control surfaces and engines are brought together to build biplanes.

videos.title: Hospital Laundry, Brass Instrument Restoration, Horse Replicas, Excavation Buckets
videos.overview: Hospital linens are sorted, disinfected, washed, dried and folded on a large industrial scale. Damaged brass instruments are dismantled, repaired and refinished; moulded forms are carefully painted and detailed to create lifelike horse replicas; and thick steel plates are cut, curved and welded into excavation buckets.

videos.title: Ceramic Fireplaces, Synthetic Corks, Parking Garage Floor Slabs
videos.overview: Heat-resistant ceramic sections are moulded, fired and assembled into fireplaces. Polymer materials are formed into synthetic bottle corks designed to provide a consistent seal, while reinforced concrete is poured into large moulds, cured and finished to produce prefabricated floor slabs for parking garages.

videos.title: Oil Pressure Sensors, Large Format Printing, Heavy Equipment Simulators, Head & Neck Restraints
videos.overview: Precision diaphragms and electronic components are assembled and calibrated to measure engine-oil pressure. Digital images are prepared and reproduced on oversized printing equipment; realistic controls, displays and motion systems are integrated into heavy-equipment simulators; and strong, lightweight materials are formed and tested as racing head-and-neck restraints.

videos.title: Mobile Concert Stages, Mascara, Continuous Miners, Wood Gift Boxes
videos.overview: Folding structural sections, hydraulic systems and performance equipment are incorporated into trailers that unfold into mobile concert stages. Pigments, waxes and other ingredients are blended and packaged as mascara; cutting heads, conveyors and tracked chassis are assembled into continuous mining machines; and selected wood is cut, joined and finished into decorative gift boxes.

videos.title: NASCAR Car Bodies, Hurley Sticks, Tube Power Amplifiers, Thermal Coffee Pots
videos.overview: Sheet metal is shaped and fitted over reinforced racing chassis to create NASCAR car bodies. Ash wood is selected, shaped and finished into traditional hurley sticks; vacuum tubes, transformers and electronic components are wired into power amplifiers; and double-walled vessels are sealed and insulated to make thermal coffee pots.

videos.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations, Grappa, Lunar Rover Replicas
videos.overview: Power electronics, cables, connectors and control systems are enclosed in weather-resistant electric-vehicle charging stations. Fermented grape residue is distilled to produce grappa, while frames, wheels, suspension components and detailed equipment are fabricated and assembled into replicas of lunar rovers.

videos.title: Slate Tiles, Hot Dog Carts, Garage Door Openers, Bicycle Seats
videos.overview: Natural slate is split into thin layers, cut to size and finished as durable roofing or flooring tiles. Stainless-steel bodies, cooking equipment and storage compartments are assembled into hot dog carts; motors, tracks and remote-control electronics become garage-door openers; and moulded bases, padding and covers are combined to produce bicycle seats.

videos.title: Racing Leathers, Evaporative Cooling Towers, Wood Rocking Chairs, Wire Wheels
videos.overview: Leather panels are cut, reinforced and sewn into protective racing suits. Fans, water-distribution systems and heat-transfer materials are assembled into evaporative cooling towers; shaped wooden components are joined and finished as rocking chairs; and spokes are individually fitted, tensioned and aligned to create wire wheels.

videos.title: Mountain Bikes, Rice, Lever Action Rifles
videos.overview: Lightweight frames are fitted with suspension, drivetrains, brakes and wheels to produce mountain bikes. Harvested rice is dried, cleaned, husked and milled for consumption, while machined metal components are fitted to wooden stocks and assembled into lever-action rifles.

videos.title: Saunas, Wheelchair Lifts, Dioramas
